title: Report a step of my continue task
description: For a task that follows your own skill or plan of several steps. Report succeeded, failed or skipped when you decide a step is done: that also starts your next listed step still pending, and the first listed step starts with the task, so one report per step is enough.
guidance: Report started only for a step out of order or one you did not list; DSphere shows your steps as the task checklist in the SidePanel and groups the page actions of each step under it in the live panel. Reporting a step makes the task a continue task: a finished run, a saved or canceled wizard or your last closed page no longer ends it, and it waits for your next step until you call dsagent.agent.work.finish (the person can still stop it; 30 idle minutes end it as interrupted). Name the task by one of its pages; without pageContextId the report goes to your latest task.

inputSchema.description: The step and the state you decided for it.

pageContextId.description: A page belonging to the task; omit to report on your latest task.

step.description: The step in your skill's own words, a few words long; the same title every time you report this step.

status.description: started when you begin the step; succeeded, failed or skipped once you decided its outcome.

taskSteps.description: The full list of your steps, in order, when you did not list them when the task started or your plan changed; steps already reported keep their state.

outputSchema.description: The task, still running, and its steps as recorded.

taskStatus.description: The task keeps running until you finish it with dsagent.agent.work.finish.

current.description: True for the step started last.
